verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm OTLP support: 'LangSmith supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing, allowing you to send traces from any OpenTelemetry-compatible application,' showing ingestion of OTLP traces. However, evidence only covers inbound trace sending, not receiving/exporting traces via OTLP, and community feedback suggests some enterprise users still resort to direct OpenTelemetry instrumentation outside LangSmith's native SDKs, implying partial/parallel support rather than full-native OTLP-first design.
